gaps: P0: none; P3: nothing with a firm date; P4: only faint stereo photos dated 1890–1922
notes: #3 is the 1645 French issue of the 1572 plate (Gallica single sheet; #5 has a page fold through the view, #6 is a smaller crop of the same plate). #7 and #9 are the two other 1699 Boudan views, equally good. #10/#11 (Daniël Veelwaard etchings) are a fine general view but the Rijksmuseum dates them only 1776–1851. #14–#18 (Olivier Bourbeau stereo photos, 1890–1922) are faint and loosely dated. #12 is a battle painting, #13 a house in Orléans.
